Recorded claim:
`commands/graph/phab-auth.mjs` exposes `postInlineReply({ commentPHID, message, revision })`; validate `PHID-XCMT-*`, authentication, CSRF, and publication success. `commands/graph/server.mjs` permits the reply endpoint only for `item.type === "inline"` with `parentCommentPHID`; revision-level feedback gets 409 rather than a detached post. [Task 1]
